I participated remotely in the ITF/OECD final conference on transport data, statistics and modelling in Ukraine, held in a hybrid format with participants gathered at the **Hyatt Regency Hotel, Kyiv** (London Room, 5 Ally Tarasovoi St).

The day combined an **in-person hands-on workshop** organised by the **International Transport Forum (ITF)** and the **Urban Reform School** under the Common Interest Group for Transport in Ukraine (CIG4U), alongside keynote presentations on building a community of transport statistics and modelling practitioners.

## Workshop programme

- **09:30 – 11:30** Interactive Exercise 1 — emerging transport data sources
- **11:30 – 12:30** Case studies: emerging methods for transport statistics and modelling
- **12:30 – 13:30** Lunch
- **13:30 – 15:00** Interactive Exercise 2 — urban travel demand modelling
- **15:00 – 16:00** Keynote speeches and open discussion
- **16:00 – 16:30** Recap and closing

## Hands-on exercises

Two interactive exercises run in **Google Colab** — no local installation required, just a Google/Gmail account.

### Exercise 1 — Infrastructure Coverage Analysis
Map a city's transport network, estimate infrastructure availability per person and identify underserved areas using **OpenStreetMap** and **WorldPop** population data.

👉 [Open Exercise 1 in Google Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/github/Robinlovelace/itfworkshop/blob/main/ITF_Workshop_Exercise_1.ipynb)

### Exercise 2 — Demand Estimation and Traffic Assignment
Build an origin-destination demand matrix using a gravity model, assign estimated trips to the road network, and develop evidence-based policy recommendations.

👉 [Open Exercise 2 in Google Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/github/Robinlovelace/itfworkshop/blob/main/ITF_Workshop_Exercise_2.ipynb)

## Keynote

My keynote — *Building a Community of Transport Statistics and Modelling Practitioners in Ukraine* — drew on experiences with open data, open source tools, and reproducible workflows in transport planning, with case studies from the UK, Spain and elsewhere.

👉 [View keynote slides](https://robinlovelace.net/itfworkshop/slides.html)
